t: Reading a hardship without blaming yourself for all of it
a: وَمَآ أَصَـٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَن كَثِيرٍ
p: Wa mā aṣābakum min muṣībatin fa-bimā kasabat aydīkum wa yaʿfū ʿan kathīr.
m: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
